as_told.title: Tim Taylor let into Vatican archives unescorted
as_told.place_text: Vatican Observatory and archives, Vatican City

plain: In the 2010s, scientists from the European Space Agency at the Vatican Observatory in Castel Gandolfo, Italy, recognised a man known as 'Tyler' the moment he was introduced by his real name, according to the scholar Diana Pasulka, who says she was there. She tells Michels 'the whole place just erupted', as if they knew him well. Michels, retelling it, gives the real name as Tim Taylor, says the scientists knew who he was, and adds that this got him led into the Vatican archives without an escort, which would suggest Taylor is far better known in space science circles than the public knows.
